title: Priyanka Chopra and Nick Jonas Host Diwali Party for Hollywood Friends in Los Angeles
excerpt: Lilly Singh, Winnie Harlow and Ashley Park were among the guests at the couple's Los Angeles home celebration, days after Priyanka shared her Karwa Chauth posts.
body:
• Priyanka Chopra and Nick Jonas hosted a Diwali celebration for Hollywood friends at their Los Angeles home, ANI reported.
  • Guests included YouTuber Lilly Singh, model Winnie Harlow, actor Ashley Park and Radhi Devlukhia, according to reports; talent agent James G. Boulter shared photographs and a video of guests dancing to live dhol.
  • Priyanka wore an embroidered Indian ensemble with a floral gajra; Nick wore a kurta-pyjama with an ethnic jacket, reports said.
  • Days earlier, Priyanka posted Karwa Chauth pictures from home, saying Nick had arranged his tour schedule to be back for it.

Priyanka Chopra and Nick Jonas hosted a Diwali party for friends and Hollywood colleagues at their home in Los Angeles, with the couple's coordinated festive looks drawing attention in photographs shared by talent agent James G. Boulter on Instagram, ANI reported.

Priyanka opted for a heavily embroidered traditional Indian ensemble with intricate beadwork and embellishments, finished with a floral gajra. Inshorts described the outfit as a maroon Indo-Western gown. Nick complemented her in a kurta-pyjama paired with an ethnic jacket. Boulter's posts showed a gathering of close friends and collaborators, including Priyanka's manager Anjula Acharia, and a video of attendees dancing to live dhol beats, ANI said.

Who was there

Reports listed YouTuber Lilly Singh and model Winnie Harlow among the guests, and WomansEra's account of the evening also named actor Ashley Park, Abla Sofy and Radhi Devlukhia, wife of podcaster Jay Shetty. Pictures and videos from the party circulated widely on social media through the weekend.

""He came home without me asking him to.."

Karwa Chauth, days before

The party followed the couple's Karwa Chauth at home, which Priyanka documented on Instagram on October 29. "He came home without me asking him to.. knowing how much it would mean to mm and I.. he made sure the tour was set up to be home for karwachauth.. No one like my guy," she wrote, according to reports of the post. She also shared a picture of Nick with their daughter Malti Marie, captioned: "Daddy's home! My whole world in one frame.. happy karwachauth."

https://x.com/filmibeat/status/2116392868839592325

The photographs matter to the couple's public story in a specific way: the celebration was documented not by the hosts but by their guests, with Boulter's Instagram post and video — guests dancing to live dhol beats at the party — becoming the primary record of the evening, ANI reported. WomansEra described the home as lit for the festival, with friends and colleagues gathered to open the festive week.

What Priyanka is working on

On the professional front, ANI reported Priyanka is preparing to return to Indian cinema with director S.S. Rajamouli's film Varanasi, co-starring Mahesh Babu, which is scheduled to release in theatres on April 7, 2027. For diaspora audiences, the Los Angeles party lands in the middle of an unusually long Diwali season in North America, with community celebrations running from mid-October into November.
